title: BPSSC Bihar Police Havildar Instructor Home Guard 2026 Exam Postponed
vacancyDetails: Havildar Instructor posts under Bihar Home Guard (Advt 06/2026); written exam postponed – new date to be announced
qualification: As per BPSSC Advt. No. 06/2026 (Matric level syllabus for written exam as notified)
ageLimit: 18 to 42 years (as per advertisement cut-off date)
applicationFee: ₹100 for all categories (as per BPSSC fee notice)
selectionProcess: Written Examination (postponed) → Further stages as per BPSSC

shortDescription: BPSSC Havildar Instructor Exam Postponed 2026 (Advt. No. 06/2026). Earlier schedule cancelled; new exam date will be announced on bpssc.bihar.gov.in.
content:
Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has postponed the written examination for Havildar Instructor recruitment under Advt. No. 06/2026 (Home Guard stream).

Applications were accepted around May–June 2026. Admit cards had been issued for the earlier schedule; the commission has now deferred the exam due to administrative / unforeseen reasons.

Current status

  • Exam status: Postponed
  • New exam date: To be announced on the official website
  • Candidates should not appear on the old date

What to do

  • Download the official postponement PDF from bpssc.bihar.gov.in
  • Do not discard previously downloaded admit card until new instructions are issued
  • Keep checking the Notices section for the revised date and admit card link

importantDates.admitCardDate: Earlier issued; revised as per new date
